## Natural history notes

A small treefrog characterized by its warty skin, pointed snout, dark triangle between the eyes, and a dark stripe running through the eye along the side of the body. In Florida, it is found in wet grassy habitats such as marshes, ponds, ditches, wet prairies, and shallow edges of wetlands. It is active near water and feeds on small insects and other invertebrates, with males giving a rapid cricket-like call during the breeding season.
